text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting! It's Smart Falcon☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My goal, of course, is to be a top Umadol 
who runs in races, dances in concerts, and 
showers everyone with sparkling hope!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, I'll steadily work hard, 
hard, and harder...! On the shining stage, 
I'll show you the absolute best Falco! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
